input.summary:
A drawing room (A first floor, x4..10 z13..23) furnished: window bench under the bay opening, a three-slab tea table with two chairs as the focal group, a desk and chair at the back-west corner, a pot-topped cabinet on the west wall. Lit by five hanging lanterns from the y=12 floor plus two lamps standing on the tops: min light 9, no dark cell.
parts/room-2.mjs is one layers() call over four levels (y8..11), with a legend of spruce stairs, fence, slab, planks, pots and lanterns. make.sh wrote a whole build.nbt; my part reports 30 placed, no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE writes.
Walk: in the real build the room reports 0 of 65 cells reachable, because the stair well isn't built yet (parts/stairs.mjs is a stub here). With a scratch copy that adds floor under the well (test only, not saved to the build), the walk is OK: 67 of 67 reachable from the well.

waste.what: Drew the furniture grid by hand for four y-levels and then checked the walk by writing a scratch copy with a floor under the stair well, because the stairs part is not built in this copy.
waste.cost: about 4 layer grids, 1 probe script, 2 make/check cycles
waste.tool: mcd room --entrance override (or a --assume-floor flag for the stair well) so the walk can be checked before the stairs part merges; a layers helper that takes furniture by name with facing and places chairs facing a table

waste.what: Worked out the stair-well and chimney cells that must stay clear by reading the plan's text (x9..10 z20..23 and x10 z18..19), since the stair part's output was unavailable.
waste.cost: about 6 coordinate checks by reading the plan grid
waste.tool: plan.md's FLOORS/RESERVED could list the exact cells each stair flight occupies at each floor (head and foot clearance), not only the well box

waste.what: Tried several light-spot placements by reading the room tool's light grid and moving lanterns, one pass each.
waste.tool: mcd room prints a suggested lantern spot list; the hanging-lantern layer could be generated from it directly

companions.task: Confirm the top landing and head clearance of the well flight that enters A's first floor, so the bench, chairs and desk can be placed against a known exit lane instead of an assumed one.
Check the light map once the rest of the house is merged (the bay's own cells are outside my box and may change the light near the window), and place a lamp in the bay if the bay cells are dark.
Make a settee with a proper back and cushions (stairs and slabs are the only seat shapes in this palette), and a bed for the bedroom corner, which this palette does not provide.

left: Walk verdict in the real build is UNREACHABLE (0 of 65 cells) only because parts/stairs.mjs is still a stub here; the well's exit is unverified. Re-run `mcd room build.nbt --rooms rooms.json --only "A drawing room"` after the stairs part merges.

The palette has no bed, candle, barrel, carpet, bookshelf or fireplace block, so the room has no bed corner and no hearth on this floor. The focal group is the bay bench, tea table and chairs; the back corner is a desk and chair. Add those ids to palette.json if the owner wants them.
Light: 0 dark cells and min 9 with the stair well and bay cells excluded from my box; the bay cells (z10..11) are outside my box and not lit by my part.
Left unticked: plan.md and elements.md have no checklist items for the interior; I built no elements.md item.

A drawing room (A first floor, x4..10 z13..23) furnished: window bench under the bay opening, a three-slab tea table with two chairs as the focal group, a desk and chair at the back-west corner, a pot-topped cabinet on the west wall. Lit by five hanging lanterns from the y=12 floor plus two lamps standing on the tops: min light 9, no dark cell.
parts/room-2.mjs is one layers() call over four levels (y8..11), with a legend of spruce stairs, fence, slab, planks, pots and lanterns. make.sh wrote a whole build.nbt; my part reports 30 placed, no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE writes.
Walk: in the real build the room reports 0 of 65 cells reachable, because the stair well isn't built yet (parts/stairs.mjs is a stub here). With a scratch copy that adds floor under the well (test only, not saved to the build), the walk is OK: 67 of 67 reachable from the well.

waste.what: Drew the furniture grid by hand for four y-levels and then checked the walk by writing a scratch copy with a floor under the stair well, because the stairs part is not built in this copy.
waste.cost: about 4 layer grids, 1 probe script, 2 make/check cycles
waste.tool: mcd room --entrance override (or a --assume-floor flag for the stair well) so the walk can be checked before the stairs part merges; a layers helper that takes furniture by name with facing and places chairs facing a table

waste.what: Worked out the stair-well and chimney cells that must stay clear by reading the plan's text (x9..10 z20..23 and x10 z18..19), since the stair part's output was unavailable.
waste.cost: about 6 coordinate checks by reading the plan grid
waste.tool: plan.md's FLOORS/RESERVED could list the exact cells each stair flight occupies at each floor (head and foot clearance), not only the well box

waste.what: Tried several light-spot placements by reading the room tool's light grid and moving lanterns, one pass each.
waste.tool: mcd room prints a suggested lantern spot list; the hanging-lantern layer could be generated from it directly

companions.task: Confirm the top landing and head clearance of the well flight that enters A's first floor, so the bench, chairs and desk can be placed against a known exit lane instead of an assumed one.
Check the light map once the rest of the house is merged (the bay's own cells are outside my box and may change the light near the window), and place a lamp in the bay if the bay cells are dark.
Make a settee with a proper back and cushions (stairs and slabs are the only seat shapes in this palette), and a bed for the bedroom corner, which this palette does not provide.

left: Walk verdict in the real build is UNREACHABLE (0 of 65 cells) only because parts/stairs.mjs is still a stub here; the well's exit is unverified. Re-run `mcd room build.nbt --rooms rooms.json --only "A drawing room"` after the stairs part merges.

The palette has no bed, candle, barrel, carpet, bookshelf or fireplace block, so the room has no bed corner and no hearth on this floor. The focal group is the bay bench, tea table and chairs; the back corner is a desk and chair. Add those ids to palette.json if the owner wants them.
Light: 0 dark cells and min 9 with the stair well and bay cells excluded from my box; the bay cells (z10..11) are outside my box and not lit by my part.
Left unticked: plan.md and elements.md have no checklist items for the interior; I built no elements.md item.
